earlierAttempt.reason: Two existing in-flight assertions expected the old non-reproduction remapping. The added whitespace-path positive fixture invoked a broader writer-request validator and supplied a mount outside the new parent; it now tests the identity guard with a contained mount. No production refusal or authority branch was weakened.

limits: The SIGKILL driver uses pure execution ports. Production primitive composition and resident entry restarts are separately exercised with synthetic external actors. External success before its durable completion receipt remains outside this recovery guarantee.
